objects.name: triangle
objects.description: Native MDL scene-data aliases: sceneData.<name> (ANARI_STRING) selects attribute0..3 or color. A geometry alias overrides the material binding for the same exact name, including when the selected attribute is absent. Unsetting restores material fallback. Empty names, non-string values and unsupported slots warn and are ignored. Existing attribute-source precedence, interpolation and uniform eligibility apply. Dynamic names are documented rather than enumerated as literal query parameters.
